notes.title: Patch v1.26
notes.content:
Hello!

Little patch for the weekend! I have to admit that I've been working on Lakeview Cabin 2 a lot this week and Valley has taken a step back. That, and I also finally build a pc and I've been slaying some demons... Been good for the mental health during these damned times. I hope everyone's doing well despite all of the stuff that's happening. Because hearing it from a random lone game developer is totally what you need...

Anyway, I still got some bugs squashed, here's the biggest ones:
[list]
[*] Increased “Pogo's” reach
[*] Tried a little fix for the black screen in cutscenes, they might load a bit longer now but at least they LOAD…

[*] Tried a little fix for that one specific butterfly ruining your hobbies with other butterflies

[*] Changed some lines in the Russian translation
[/list]

notes.title: Beta for the new features is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Some good news and some bad news! I've talked about this on the Lakeview Discord, but I thought I'd write something here too.  Good news is that it's the holidays and we're soon moving to a bigger apartment. Bad news is that it's the holidays and we're soon moving to a bigger apartment, which means that I haven't been able to work on the game as much as I have wanted. I know I promised the big update before Christmas, but life got in the way... I'm so sorry for not being able to deliver that...
Buuuut I decided to upload a Beta for everything I've been working on for Lakeview Valley, which [b]you can access from the games properties[/b]. A lot of the new stuff is still WIP, but there's some improved stuff to the base game (or at least I hope they're an improvement) so I feel like it's a nice patch in it's own. I'm just so sorry I wasn't able to get everything done I wanted. But now I need to take a breather and focus on the other stuff for a moment.
I hope you all have great holidays! I'll be back full-force in January!


For now, here's all the stuff that has been changed in the beta:
[list]
[*] Added flower-planting
[*] Added a pipe to smoke the flowers out of (status effects are not hooked up yet so it doesn’t do much)
[*] Added a teamug to drink some flower-tea out of (same issues as the pipe)
[*] Added a mailbox so you can receive letters, and maybe a gift or two
[*] Added butterflies
[*] Added more stuff to that trash thing
[*] Added more stuff to that big thing
[*] Added more stuff to that thing that scares the crows (this is very unfinished)
[*] Nerfed all the melee weapons
[*] The villagers will now get a bit stronger and faster every time you “travel”
[*] Added new stat “Base damage”, which affects how much damage you do (duh).
[*] Added new stat “Metabolism”, which affects how quickly you need to eat after gaining stamina.
[*] Added new stat “Sauna Skill”, which affects how much heat you can take in a sauna
[*] Added new stat “Mojo”, which affects how well you perform during THAT minigame
[*] Added new stat “Blood thickness”, which reduces the amount you bleed from wounds.
[*] Added new stat “Luck”, which affects how easily you find seeds with the shovel
[*] Another fix for the speed boost staying into the next day
[*] The doors at the town won’t lock anymore. It’s easier on the players this way, and nothing bad ever happens at the Valley so why would they lock them anyway…
[*] Extended the overworld theme, even though I believe a shorter loop makes people more murderous…
[*] Added a mute button for the overworld music in the pause menu
[*] The “murder-theme” will now play when near any corpse, instead of only when near the bus accident victim
[*] Added a thermometer to the sauna, which will show just how hot it is. Taking a good sauna will increase your metabolism stat.
[*] Tried to optimize the beach area so it will load faster (this was happening because of the stage updating the pathfinder map every time you entered the area, it might still happen since it’s required, but not as often.)
[*] Getting killed by the Sheriff won’t immediately subtract from your popularity points
[*] Changed the “ineedmytools” cheat to give you only tools
[*] Added cheat “greenthumb” to give you all gardening items
[*] Added cheat “imhangry” to give you some food items
[*] Added cheat “dontlookatme” to give you all the masks and Amy’s face
[*] Added cheat “eenymeeny” to give you a selection of weapons
[*] Added cheat “thatstuff” to give you misc. items that didn’t fit into the other item cheats
[*] Added cheat “movethatbus” that gives you all the furniture (in white color)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.02
notes.content:
v1.02
First patch after release! I wasn't able to get everything I wanted done today but tomorrow is a new day! If you're enjoying the game, consider leaving a review, it really helps the game to show up to more people!

Here's a list of all the changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the looping problem if you go into the water on the last Sunday
[*] Found a possible reason that might’ve caused the Sheriff to always say you were reported of suspicious activity, even if you weren’t, fixed it
[*] Made the footstep sounds stop when you’re in a cutscene
[*] Dropping an item while swimming will now make you lose the item! So be careful not to drop anything valuable!
[*] Made sure the severed heads get removed if you travel
[*] You should now be able to exit the map with the “B button” on a controller
[*] Added a little more feedback for when you kill that mysterious creature
[*] Made sure the footsteps get muted when you pause the game
[*] Fixed (hopefully) the mysterious creature’s animation problems
[*] Fixed Matt thinking that Donna is dead right after starting a new game
[*] Added the big guy to the list that gets reset if you travel
[*] Fixed the collider problem near the abandoned house
[*] Made sure the number of snakes you have killed will reset if you travel
[*] Fixed Ruth doing that weird teleport thing at the beginning of the game
[*] Fixed the thing on that bridge in that one place not counting the killed villagers properly
[*] Fixed the prices at Amy’s stall AGAIN SINCE I’M AN IDIOT!
[*] Fixed Morgo telling the story again and again and again
[*] Made sure Luanne actually leaves when she is done at your home
[*] The shotgun works, but the spread made it miss easily, so I doubled the amount of pellets it releases on a shot
[*] Made it so that one gentleman acts independently on LakeDay if you haven’t taken any help from him
[*] Made it so the shroom affects a certain dialogue between two characters
[*] Tried a little fix for the Mystery Ladys certain dialogue not activating properly. Not sure if it helped since I couldn’t find an obvious reason for what might cause it
[*] Added some dialogue if you bring the Sheriff to a certain place
[*] Made it so the game also saves your current selected inventory slot, not sure if it helps with the item duplication problem but fingers crossed!
[*] Fixed the weird clipping problem with Mary
[*] I reduced the time warp speed that happens when you sit on a bench. The minutes should still go about as fast as before but the characters will move a bit slower. The faster it goes, the easier they get stuck inside walls so let’s try this
[/list]
